The paper has the word '細紋' printed at the top and contains a close-up photograph of skin with prominent wrinkles. The background is a bright red, textured surface resembling a leather mat. The hand makes green checkmarks next to 'A醇' and 'EGF'. (2) The scene shifts as a new sheet of paper is revealed, titled '毛孔粗大' with an image showing enlarged skin pores. The hand uses the marker to highlight and check off '水楊酸' and 'A醇' beneath the image. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the paper and the skin photo. (4) The hand flips to a page titled '乾性肌', showing an image of dry, flaky skin around a person's mouth. The marker is used to highlight and check the ingredients '玻尿酸' and '比菲德氏菌'. The hand wears a watch and has neatly trimmed nails. (5) The final information page titled '光老化' is shown, featuring an image of skin with sunspots. The hand checks off '光解酶', '維他命C', and '一堆美白成分' while moving the marker smoothly across the paper. (6) The video concludes with a clean graphic transition to a white background featuring the 'DRX' logo and the brand name '達特仕保養品 DRX SERIES SKINCARE' in black text, accompanied by abstract grey curved lines.
